comparisons.name: window-light
comparisons.description: The whole Contacts window, Aqua: the card of Stephen Hackett being edited, with the label menu of the email field opened by a real click and the pointer on work. The capture is a region of the desktop: the sidebar is the vibrant material over the desktop picture, which tints it from beige to blue. The example uses the opaque sidebar and the picture is not reproduced, so the sidebar and the line beside it, which the capture blends with the picture, are masked (unmasked, the crop scores 22.8% at 2x, the sidebar alone). Whole crop otherwise: the text is set in the fallback font; the glyphs of the card's actions are stand-in drawings; and every control is the library's as the library draws it, where Contacts draws its own. The Info and Picture control is the segmented control with its accent segment; a label is a small pop-up button without a bezel, 11 pt where the capture has 12 pt; the name is edited in two text fields given the name's 18 pt; the plus button is 38 pt wide where the capture has 34. The label menu hangs from a pop-up button as wide as its title, so it stands about 5 pt right of the captured one. The first phone field has no selection and no focus ring, because the browser's focus is in the open menu; and the email address is a stand-in.

comparisons.name: window-light-layout
comparisons.description: As window-light with the text and the stand-in glyphs masked as well: the search placeholder; the three names and the mark of the user's card; the initials, the name, the company placeholder and the checkbox's title; the two segment titles; every field's label and value, the first phone field with its selection and focus ring included; the four titles of the open menu and the part of the ringtone label that shows under it; the plus, the title of Done and the share glyph. Scores the frame, the search field, the selected name, the dividers, the picture's disc, the checkbox, the segmented control, the remove buttons, the pop-up buttons' arrows, the rules between the fields, the menu's surface, highlight and checkmark, the rule over the bar and the three bezels in it. What remains is the library's drawing where Contacts has its own. Most of the differing pixels at 2x are the accent segment where the capture has a flat grey one, and the menu, which stands about 5 pt right of the captured one and is 1 pt wider in the fallback font; the rest are the search field's lighter outline, the arrows of the pop-up buttons beside the values, and the bar, whose plus button is 4 pt wider than captured. Three masks follow what moved when the demo stopped restyling the library's controls: the plus's is 2 pt wider, for the glyph centred in the wider button; Custom…'s is 1 pt wider, for the menu's titles that start further right; and the share glyph's is put on the glyph, 875.5 to 888.5 pt, which the mask at 869 to 884 pt half missed.

comparisons.name: window-dark
comparisons.description: The whole Contacts window, Dark Aqua: the finished card of Stephen Hackett with the action menu of the work label opened by a real click and the pointer on Send Message. No service is set up, as on the Mac of the capture, so the four buttons under the name are dimmed. The sidebar is opaque where the capture's is tinted by the desktop picture; in Dark Aqua the two are a few levels apart, so nothing is masked. Whole crop: the text is set in the fallback font, which makes the menu 182 pt wide where the capture has 179, and the glyphs of the card's actions are stand-in drawings. The controls are the library's as the library draws them: the four buttons under the name are regular round buttons, 20 pt discs where the capture has 24 pt ones; the names of the groups start 18 pt from the edge, the library's row, where the capture has 20 pt; the plus button is 38 pt wide where the capture has 33; and the list of names has the list view's own background, a level or two from the captured pane's.

comparisons.name: window-dark-layout
comparisons.description: As window-dark with the text and the stand-in glyphs masked: the sidebar's five titles; the search placeholder and the two names; the initials and the name; the glyphs and the captions of the four buttons; FaceTime, the two labels and the three titles of the menu; the glyph of the mail badge; the plus, the title of Edit and the share glyph. Scores the frame, the window controls, the sidebar's surface and selection, the search field, the selected name, the dividers, the picture's disc, the four dimmed discs, the rules, the label's capsule, the menu's surface and highlight, the badge's disc and the three bezels of the bar. Of the differing pixels at 2x, 43% are the window's top edge, which the capture draws lighter than the other three and the library's window does not; 28% the four discs, 20 pt in the library's round button where the capture has 24 pt; 18% the menu's width and rim; 5% the bar, whose plus button is 5 pt wider than captured. Three kinds of mask follow what moved when the demo stopped restyling the library's controls: those of the three group names start 2 pt further left, as the names do in the library's row; the plus's is 2 pt wider, for the glyph centred in the wider button; and the share glyph's is put on the glyph, 875.5 to 888.5 pt, which the mask at 869 to 884 pt half missed.
